grammar.purpose: Use natural adjective reduplication in context
grammar.explanation: Some adjectives repeat as AA or AABB to make a description vivid: 红红的、干干净净. The reduplicated form usually does not take 很 directly before it: 干干净净, not 很干干净净. This is not a rule that every adjective can be repeated. Use 清清楚楚 and 开开心心 for manner/state when appropriate; the meaning is not a numerical comparison.

examples.zh: 红红的围巾，是朋友送的。
examples.py: hóng hóng de wéi jīn , shì péng you sòng de .
examples.en: The red scarf was a gift from a friend.

examples.zh: 白色的衣服洗得干干净净。
examples.py: bái sè de yī fú xǐ dé gān gān jìng jìng .
examples.en: The white clothes have been washed nice and clean.

examples.zh: 我们开开心心地去见朋友。
examples.py: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn de qù jiàn péng you .
examples.en: We go happily to meet our friends.

commonMistakes.why: The vivid AABB form does not normally follow 很 here.

grammar.purpose: Describe a property or a comparison precisely
grammar.explanation: An adjective phrase can include degree or negation: 有点凉、不太重、很合适. It can describe a noun with 的 or act as a predicate without 是: 不太重的衣服; 这件衣服不太重. 很 often gives a neutral predicate rather than extreme intensity. In 价格不低, the property is price, not physical height or the owner’s status.

examples.zh: 晚上有点凉，带不太重的衣服。
examples.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài bù tài zhòng de yī fú .
examples.en: It is a little cool at night; bring clothes that are not too heavy.

examples.zh: 这双鞋很合适，价格不低。
examples.py: zhè shuāng xié hěn hé shì , jià gé bù dī .
examples.en: These shoes fit well and are not cheap.

examples.py: lǜ sè de nà jiàn bǐ jiào qīng .
examples.en: That green one is relatively light.

commonMistakes.why: Use the adjective phrase directly as the neutral predicate; 是 would require an emphasis context.

grammar.explanation: 又…又… joins qualities that hold of the same referent: 又轻又短、又普通又舒服. It does not mean one quality belongs to one person and the other to someone else. Both may be positive or negative; the conjunction itself is not praise. Do not force contradictory qualities in the same sense without explaining different parts or circumstances.

examples.py: lǜ sè de yī fú yòu qīng yòu duǎn .
examples.en: The green garment is both light and short.

examples.zh: 这双鞋又重又贵，我今天不穿。
examples.py: zhè shuāng xié yòu zhòng yòu guì , wǒ jīn tiān bù chuān .
examples.en: These shoes are both heavy and expensive; I will not wear them today.

examples.zh: 这个样子又可爱又自然。
examples.py: zhè gè yàng zi yòu kě ài yòu zì rán .
examples.en: This look is both cute and natural.

commonMistakes.why: After each 又 use a compatible predicate, not a bare colour noun such as 蓝色.

dialogue.title: Not a dress code
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Find the chosen outfit and the actual requirements.

lines.zh: 今天见朋友，要穿什么颜色？
lines.py: jīn tiān jiàn péng you , yào chuān shén me yán sè ?
lines.en: What colour should I wear to meet our friends today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 只是普通的见面，没有说要统一颜色。
lines.py: zhǐ shì pǔ tōng de jiàn miàn , méi yǒu shuō yào tǒng yī yán sè .
lines.en: It is just an ordinary meeting; nobody said we must wear the same colour.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 蓝色、绿色、黄色，我有三件。
lines.py: lán sè , lǜ sè , huáng sè , wǒ yǒu sān jiàn .
lines.en: I have three garments: blue, green and yellow.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 绿色的那件又轻又短，晚上有点凉，带蓝色的吧。
lines.py: lǜ sè de nà jiàn yòu qīng yòu duǎn , wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , dài lán sè de ba .
lines.en: The green one is light and short. It is a little cool in the evening; bring the blue one.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 黄的还没干，今天不穿。白色的洗得干干净净。
lines.py: huáng de hái méi gàn , jīn tiān bù chuān . bái sè de xǐ dé gān gān jìng jìng .
lines.en: The yellow one is not dry; I will not wear it today. The white one is washed nice and clean.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那穿白色的，再带蓝色的，怎么样？
lines.py: nà chuān bái sè de , zài dài lán sè de , zěn me yàng ?
lines.en: How about wearing white and bringing the blue one?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。黑色的鞋合适，走路舒服，但价格不低。
lines.py: hǎo . hēi sè de xié hé shì , zǒu lù shū fú , dàn jià gé bù dī .
lines.en: Okay. The black shoes fit and are comfortable for walking, though not cheap.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是黑的就可以，不用特别贵。你有红色的围巾吗？
lines.py: shì hēi de jiù kě yǐ , bù yòng tè bié guì . nǐ yǒu hóng sè de wéi jīn ma ?
lines.en: Black is fine; it need not be especially expensive. Do you have a red scarf?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 有。红红的，朋友送的。绿色的和红色的一起穿，会不会太特别？
lines.py: yǒu . hóng hóng de , péng you sòng de . lǜ sè de hé hóng sè de yì qǐ chuān , huì bù huì tài tè bié ?
lines.en: Yes. Red, a gift from a friend. Would wearing green and red together be too unusual?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你喜欢就行。这个样子很可爱，不是考试。
lines.py: nǐ xǐ huān jiù xíng . zhè gè yàng zi hěn kě ài , bù shì kǎo shì .
lines.en: If you like it, that is fine. The look is cute; this is not an exam.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我还担心鞋不够轻。
lines.py: wǒ hái dān xīn xié bù gòu qīng .
lines.en: I am still worried the shoes are not light enough.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 合身、舒服就好。开开心心去见朋友，别猜一个不存在的要求。
lines.py: hé shēn , shū fú jiù hǎo . kāi kāi xīn xīn qù jiàn péng you , bié cāi yī gè bù cún zài de yāo qiú .
lines.en: Fit and comfort are enough. Go happily to meet friends; do not guess at a requirement that was never stated.
lines.speaker: b

reading.purpose: Read to distinguish clothes worn, brought and left at home.

lines.zh: 今天只是朋友见面，穿普通的衣服就好，没有统一颜色的要求。
lines.py: jīn tiān zhǐ shì péng you jiàn miàn , chuān pǔ tōng de yī fú jiù hǎo , méi yǒu tǒng yī yán sè de yāo qiú .
lines.en: Today we are just meeting friends; ordinary clothes are fine, with no required uniform colour.

lines.zh: 我有蓝色、绿色、黄色的衣服。绿的又轻又短，黄的还没干。
lines.py: wǒ yǒu lán sè , lǜ sè , huáng sè de yī fú . lǜ de yòu qīng yòu duǎn , huáng de hái méi gàn .
lines.en: I have blue, green and yellow clothes. The green one is light and short; the yellow one is not dry.

lines.zh: 白色的洗得干干净净，我决定穿白色的。
lines.py: bái sè de xǐ dé gān gān jìng jìng , wǒ jué dìng chuān bái sè de .
lines.en: The white one is nice and clean, so I decide to wear it.

lines.py: wǎn shang yǒu diǎn liáng , wǒ dài lán sè de , bù shì zài chuān lǜ sè de .
lines.en: The evening is a little cool; I bring the blue one rather than wear the green one too.

lines.zh: 黑色的鞋合身，走路舒服。价格不低，但今天不用再买。
lines.py: hēi sè de xié hé shēn , zǒu lù shū fú . jià gé bù dī , dàn jīn tiān bù yòng zài mǎi .
lines.en: The black shoes fit and are comfortable for walking. They were not cheap, but I do not need to buy more today.

lines.zh: 红红的围巾是朋友送的，对我很特别。
lines.py: hóng hóng de wéi jīn shì péng you sòng de , duì wǒ hěn tè bié .
lines.en: The red scarf was a gift from a friend and is special to me.

lines.zh: 朋友说这个样子可爱，我听了很开心。颜色好不好看，每个人想法可以不同。
lines.py: péng you shuō zhè gè yàng zi kě ài , wǒ tīng le hěn kāi xīn . yán sè hǎo bù hǎo kàn , měi gè rén xiǎng fǎ kě yǐ bù tóng .
lines.en: My friend says this look is cute, and I am happy to hear it. People may differ on how attractive a colour is.

lines.zh: 我们开开心心去见朋友，不把搭配当成绩，也不把个人意见当要求。
lines.py: wǒ men kāi kāi xīn xīn qù jiàn péng you , bù bǎ dā pèi dàng chéng jì , yě bù bǎ gè rén yì jiàn dāng yāo qiú .
lines.en: We go happily to meet friends; we do not grade outfits or treat personal opinions as requirements.
